rationale: The assistant correctly identified the gurgling, clicking and cracking as normal operating noises, gave sensible checks (level, clearance, cooling), and used the customer's reported evidence in the second reply. It recommended no part or repair and set sensible escalation criteria (loud buzzing is not mentioned, but repeated clicking, poor cooling and oily residue are). It was slightly confident in places and repeated the escalation list, but overall it served the homeowner well.
